# Jithin Sebastian

> Jithin Sebastian is the Head of Engineering at Mozilor, the company behind the CookieYes consent management platform. He also leads information security and research and development at Mozilor.

## Key facts

- Role: Head of Engineering at Mozilor (https://www.mozilor.com/), also leading information security and R&D
- Career: joined Mozilor as an engineer and grew into Head of Engineering
- Product: CookieYes (https://www.cookieyes.com/), a cookie consent management platform
- Experience: more than 10 years in software engineering, over 5 at Mozilor
- Scaled CookieYes from 100,000 to more than 1.5 million users over three to four years
- Built data pipelines handling over 3 billion requests a day
- Architected large-scale web scanning infrastructure for cookie scanning
- Established 24/7 SRE support to reduce incident response time
- Mozilor holds ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type 2 certifications
- Drove AI adoption across Mozilor: agentic coding company-wide, with manual coding at zero
- Oversaw AI implementations: agency and affiliate verification pipelines, automated cookie classification, customer support assistant
- Areas: backend systems (Node.js, Go, Python), data (data streaming, Elasticsearch, PostgreSQL, Redis), cloud (AWS, GCP, Kubernetes, Terraform), security and privacy engineering (GDPR), AI in consent management

## Open source

- [md-to-rich](https://md-to-rich.jithins.dev/): TypeScript library that converts Markdown to HTML, ANSI terminal output and a typed document tree for ProseMirror, Slate and Quill (MIT; GitHub: https://github.com/jithinsk/markdown-to-richtext; npm: md-to-rich)
- [EmDash Header & Footer Code](https://emdash-code.jithins.dev/): EmDash plugin that adds analytics, verification tags, chat widgets and custom CSS/JS to pages without theme edits (MIT; GitHub: https://github.com/jithinsk/emdash-header-footer-code; npm: emdash-header-footer-code)
